integrity: The proof is supplied with an executable finite checker; finite tests are corroborative rather than a proof of the infinite-family statement. The prior rational representation is attributed, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on the published nonequivariant homotopy theorem; applies only to the two canonical reflections on linear chains; equivalent unindexed work may exist. No independent scientific audit was performed.
title: Integral Klein-four homology lattice of linear hexagonal chains
